'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|So, ready for some serious work? Long story short, the tourists have started getting on my nerves. They're sticking their noses everywhere, taking ou my lads, messing with my supply routes. I don't like it one bit. I'll pay you nicely if you give them a proper shake-up.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 5 PMCs operatives

==Rewards==
* +10,000 [[EXP]]
*[[Skier]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.25'''</font>
* 1,000 Euros
** 1,050 Euros with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 1,150 Euros with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
{{quote|Not bad. Here, take these little gifts. By the way, you took out one of their big shots. They’re properly shitting themselves now.}}

In this quest you have to eliminate 5 PMCs on any map.
